name: Hawker Sea Fury
summary: The Royal Navy's last piston fighter, with a Bristol Centaurus sleeve-valve radial and a five-blade propeller; a handful fly in the US and race at Reno.

wings: Long, straight, tapered low wing with rounded tips
Folding wing on the naval version
Narrow, tall main gear with a wide track
engines: Large radial (or racing R-3350) in a long, smooth cowl
Five-blade propeller on the Centaurus; fewer blades on racers
fuselage: Long, slim fuselage with a bubble canopy
Tailwheel gear on a slender body
tail: Tall fin with a large rounded rudder
Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage

tellTales: Large radial in a long, smooth cowl with a five-blade propeller
Long, slim fuselage with a bubble canopy and a straight low wing
Arrestor hook and tall main gear on a slim fighter

confusedWith.howToTell: The Mustang has an inline V-12 nose and a belly scoop; the Sea Fury has a radial cowl and no belly scoop.
The Bearcat is smaller and stubbier with a bigger-looking cowl; the Sea Fury is longer and slimmer.
The Corsair has inverted gull wings; the Sea Fury has a straight wing.
The Thunderbolt is a huge barrel-chested airframe with a chin intake; the Sea Fury is slim with a smooth cowl.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
